sentences.text: BEFORE  HON'BLE SHRI JUSTICE VISHAL MISHRA  ON THE 7 th OF NOVEMBER, 2024

Appearance:
 Mr. B.K. Vaishya - Advocate for applicant.
 Ms. Nupur Dhamija - Advocate for respondent/State.

ORDER This is the seventh application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of CrPC for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.292 of 2022 registered at Police Station Waidhan District Singrauli (M.P.)
for the offences under Sections 304B, 498A and 34 of IPC and Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
The appellant who is husband of the deceased is in judicial custody since 27.02.2022.

Earlier applications were considered and dismissed on merits vide order dated 09.09.2022 passed in MCrC No.31850 of 2022, order dated 17.03.2023 passed in MCrC No.6274 of 2023 and order dated 20.10.2023 passed in MCrC No.42984 of 2023.
2.
This time the bail is pleaded inter alia on the ground of delay in trial.
However, there is no material placed before this court to show that there is substantial delay in the trial.
The applicant's counsel could not point any new development in the case to enable him to file subsequent application for grant of bail.

Merely the argument that on earlier occasion, certain facts NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:55446 2 MCRC-29543-2024 could not be pointed before the court cannot be a ground to entertain subsequent application in the event that on three occasions, the application for bail was considered and rejected on merits.

After rejection of the earlier applications,
no new ground is made out for grant of bail.
